meta.label: REAL USGS gauge pairs, 2024–2026 events; TEST already seen in v1 (second look, optimistic)
meta.test_reuse_note: TEST was already seen in v1, so v2 is a second look at the same test set and its numbers are optimistic. z itself was chosen on TRAIN only.

rule.v2_change: projected branch requires rate - z * rate_sigma >= R_FAST (rate_sigma = filter_series(...).rate_sigma_m_per_h); warning-reached branch unchanged

z_selection.rule: smallest z in [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0] with TRAIN p95/camera_noise upstream false alerts <= 1.0 per 30 days per pair and TRAIN p95/gauge combined detection >= detection at z = 0 minus 0.05; if none meets both, the largest z that keeps the detection condition (the false-alert target is then reported as not met).

meta.data_source: USGS NWIS instantaneous gauge height (00065), U.S. public domain, credit U.S. Geological Survey; NWS action stages from NOAA NWPS where the datum check passed. U.S. rivers, not Nepal/India.
